name: tuning
title: Numeric tuning and program search
summary: Score the selected candidate's validation objective under a declared evaluation allowance. The private holdout is read once, after selection, through a separate final read.
goal: Lower the validation objective without leaving the search space, exceeding the allowance, or selecting on holdout results.
targetGuidance: Set the bar a small fraction below the measured validation baseline; keep validation and holdout instances disjoint and read the holdout once, after selection.

guardDetails.bounds: Every trial's parameters are inside the declared space and no two trials repeat a parameter set.
guardDetails.allowance: The trial evaluations stay within the declared allowance.
guardDetails.no_leakage: No trial row carries holdout results.
guardDetails.selection: The selected trial has the best validation objective.
guardDetails.disjoint: Validation and holdout instances do not overlap.

data.result: JSONL rows: trial rows {"trial": n, "params": {...}, "validation": number, "evaluations": n} plus one selected row {"selected": n, "params": {...}, "evaluations": n}. The final read adds "holdout": {instance: number} to the selected row.

knownBad.reason: the selected trial is the best available but its validation objective is worse than the baseline
batch_size 128 is outside the declared space
the trial evaluations exceed the allowance
two trials repeat the same parameters
the selected trial is not the best validation objective
a trial row carries holdout results

finalControls.reason: the selected row does not cover every holdout instance
the holdout instances overlap the validation instances

repeats.why: the adapter is deterministic; repeat real tuner runs to measure noise

notes: Selection happens on validation. The final read is separate and run once; it is the only path that reads holdout metrics. Changing the holdout cannot change the visible score.
